name: tfcensus
short: Take a census of Terraform/OpenTofu and Terragrunt fleets on AWS

children.name: audit
children.short: Audit state backends

children.name: backend
children.short: Check state buckets, lock tables and the fleet of states

children.name: cache
children.short: Inspect or clear the probe and scan caches

children.name: clear
children.short: Delete every entry of both caches

children.name: info
children.short: Show each cache's directory, entry count, size and freshness

children.name: codify
children.short: Write import blocks for unmanaged resources from a scan report

children.name: completion
children.short: Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell

children.name: config
children.short: Inspect and validate configuration

children.name: init
children.short: Write a commented config file

children.name: path
children.short: Print the config file locations tfcensus reads

children.name: show
children.short: Print the effective configuration

children.name: validate
children.short: Validate config files against the schema

children.name: doctor
children.short: Check tool versions, AWS credentials and the inventory layers of each account and region

children.name: drift
children.short: Find drift between the units' state and AWS

children.name: inventory
children.short: Read each unit's state: versions, providers, resource counts, serial and lineage

children.name: mcp
children.short: Serve units, inventory, whois, scan_summary, audit_findings and drift_summary to an MCP client over stdio

children.name: move
children.short: Move resources between the states of Terragrunt units

children.name: apply
children.short: Apply a migration file to the units' states

children.name: mark-applied
children.short: Record migration blocks as applied without changing state

children.name: plan
children.short: Verify a migration file with plans, without writing anything

children.name: rollback
children.short: Restore the states a migration file changed

children.name: status
children.short: Show whether each migration block is applied in each unit

children.name: suggest
children.short: Draft a migration file from the moves that plans show

children.name: notify
children.short: Publish saved scan, drift and audit reports to Slack, GitHub, Bitbucket or files

children.name: report
children.short: Render saved scan, drift, audit and index files without collecting again

children.name: audit
children.short: List the findings of a saved backend audit, highest severity first

children.name: drift
children.short: Summarize a saved drift run: unit statuses and drifted resources

children.name: html
children.short: Write a static HTML report from scan, drift and audit JSON

children.name: inventory
children.short: Count the managed resources of a saved state index per unit and type

children.name: scan
children.short: Summarize a saved scan: counts and the top unmanaged resources

children.name: units
children.short: List the units of a saved state index

children.name: rules
children.short: Work with ownership rules

children.name: test
children.short: Compile ownership rules and evaluate them against sample resources, offline

children.name: scan
children.short: Find AWS resources that no unit manages

children.name: units
children.short: List units with their state backend, target account and region

children.name: version
children.short: Print version and build information

children.name: whois
children.short: Show which units manage an AWS resource
